title: CPF Module Schema: Azure DataFactory Trigger module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-datafactorytrigger'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

schedule_trigger_config.type: map(object({ data_factory_id = string description = optional(string) schedule = optional(object({ days_of_month = optional(list(number)) days_of_week = optional(list(string)) hours = optional(list(number)) minutes = optional(list(number)) monthly = optional(object({ weekday = string week = optional(number) })) })) start_time = optional(string) time_zone = optional(string) end_time = optional(string) interval = optional(number, 1) frequency = optional(string, "Minute") activated = optional(bool, true) pipeline = optional(list(object({ name = optional(string) parameters = optional(map(string)) }))) annotations = optional(list(string)) }))
schedule_trigger_config.description: (Optional) Map of Data Factory Schedule Trigger configurations. Each trigger supports: data_factory_id: (Required) The Data Factory ID in which to associate the Linked Service with. description: (Optional) The Schedule Trigger's description. schedule: (Optional) A schedule block to specify the recurrence schedule with: days_of_month: (Optional) Day(s) of the month (1-31). Monthly frequency only. days_of_week: (Optional) Days of the week (e.g., ["Monday", "Friday"]). Weekly frequency only. hours: (Optional) Hours of the day (0-23). minutes: (Optional) Minutes of the hour (0-59). monthly: (Optional) Monthly schedule with: weekday: (Required) Day of the week (e.g., "Sunday"). week: (Optional) Week occurrence (-1 for last, 1-4 for specific week). start_time: (Optional) The time the Schedule Trigger will start (UTC). Defaults to current time. time_zone: (Optional) The timezone of the start/end time. end_time: (Optional) The time the Schedule Trigger should end (UTC). interval: (Optional) The interval for trigger occurrence. Defaults to 1. frequency: (Optional) Trigger frequency: Minute, Hour, Day, Week, Month. Defaults to Minute. activated: (Optional) Specifies if the trigger is activated. Defaults to true. pipeline: (Optional) List of pipeline blocks. Each block supports: name: (Required) Reference pipeline name. parameters: (Optional) Pipeline parameters. annotations: (Optional) List of tags for describing the trigger.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

triggerschedule_id.description: Map of Data Factory Schedule Trigger IDs.

triggerschedule_name.description: Map of Data Factory Schedule Trigger names.

triggerschedule_resource.description: Map of Data Factory Schedule Trigger resources.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Datafactorytrigger' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
